title: ONSure Policy Profile v1
description: 02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md FR-COM-013: regulated-industry Enterprise Edition enforces Separation of Duties (the same actor cannot both develop -- Patch apply -- and verify/accept the same ImprovementRequest); a general Plan only recommends SoD, it does not enforce it. sod_enforcement is the single switch between those two behaviors, evaluated by SeparationOfDutiesLedger.

allOf.description: FR-COM-013: SoD is only ever ENFORCED for a regulated industry class -- STANDARD stays ADVISORY (recommend, don't block).
